repos.name: rustrak/rustrak
repos.description: Self-hosted, open-source Sentry alternative in Rust. Error tracking, performance, logs and AI agent traces in one small container that works with the Sentry SDKs. SQLite or PostgreSQL.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, self-hosted observability platform written in Rust that serves as an open-source alternative to Sentry.
bullets: Built with Rust for memory safety and high-concurrency performance.
Supports SQLite or PostgreSQL backends for flexible deployment.
Provides unified error tracking, logging, and performance monitoring.
Includes native support for AI agent trace visualization and Sentry SDK compatibility.

repos.name: INK-Q/agy-fast
repos.description: Non-invasive MCP accelerator plugin for Google Antigravity (CLI/Desktop/IDE): cuts LLM turns (-34%), token quota (-31%), and upload traffic (-40%) without affecting native UI or diffs.
repos.one_liner: A non-invasive MCP accelerator plugin designed to optimize LLM interactions by reducing latency and token consumption.
bullets: Implements an MCP (Model Context Protocol) acceleration layer for CLI and IDE environments.
Reduces LLM turn counts by 34% and token usage by 31% through intelligent caching.
Optimizes upload traffic by 40% without altering native UI or diff workflows.
Ideal for developers looking to lower API costs and improve agentic response speeds.

repos.name: ChiefGyk3D/Clouds-Against-Humanity
repos.description: Learn cloud security by building it! An open-source homelab teaching Zero Trust, DevSecOps, IaC, and cloud architecture from the ground up.
repos.one_liner: An open-source, hands-on educational platform for mastering cloud security, DevSecOps, and infrastructure architecture.
bullets: Focuses on building secure homelab environments to teach Zero Trust principles.
Covers Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and modern cloud security best practices.
Provides a structured curriculum for engineers to move from basic networking to complex cloud architecture.
Essential for professionals aiming to bridge the gap between theoretical security and practical implementation.

repos.name: pingdotgg/t3code
repos.description: The best way to control Claude Code, Codex and more from any computer or phone
repos.one_liner: A unified interface and control layer for managing AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex across multiple devices.
bullets: Provides a centralized command-and-control interface for various LLM-based coding agents.
Enables cross-platform accessibility, allowing developers to trigger agentic workflows from mobile or desktop.
Simplifies the orchestration of complex AI-driven development tasks.
Highly relevant for power users integrating AI agents into their daily software development lifecycle.

repos.name: mjmirza/app-store-compliance
repos.description: Avoid common App Store and Google Play rejections. Open playbook and pre-submission guard with 117 documented rejection patterns and fixes, privacy manifest and Data safety checks, 95 tracked deadlines (EU AI Act, DSA, COPPA, age laws), and a skill for AI coding agents.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive open-source playbook and compliance guard for navigating App Store and Google Play submission requirements.
bullets: Tracks 117 documented rejection patterns and provides actionable remediation steps.
Includes automated checks for privacy manifests and data safety disclosures.
Maintains a database of 95+ tracked regulatory and platform deadlines.
Critical infrastructure for fintech or consumer apps that require frequent, compliant deployment cycles.
